name: part_year
input:
If you were a resident of Canada for part of the year, include the income for the part of the year you were a resident of
Canada plus any income and losses referred to in paragraphs 115(1)(a) to (c) of the Income Tax Act as reported on your
Canadian tax return, for the part of the year you were not a resident of Canada.
